mat-cs101-syllabus: CS101 covers algorithm analysis, sorting, trees and graphs. Assessment is one assignment, a graph project checkpoint, and a written exam on 12 December 2026.
mat-cs101-sorting: Compares insertion sort, mergesort and quicksort, with emphasis on average vs worst-case complexity and when a stable sort matters.
mat-cs101-a1: Build a sorting visualiser for insertion sort and mergesort. Submit via the portal before 23:59 on 14 October 2026. Pair work is allowed.
mat-cs101-graphs: Introduces BFS, DFS and Dijkstra. The graph project checkpoint is due 28 November 2026.
mat-db201-syllabus: DB201 is an introduction to relational databases: ER modelling, SQL, and normalisation. Key dates include Assignment 1 on 14 October, a midterm on 2 November, and the exam on 15 December 2026.
mat-db201-sql: Covers SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY and subqueries, mapping each construct back to relational algebra.
mat-db201-er: Design an ER diagram for a library system and submit it before 23:59 on 14 October 2026.
mat-db201-norm: Walks through 1NF, 2NF and 3NF with a running example. The normalisation mini-project is due 20 November 2026.
